cameraInstructions: Film from the front with the full body and both feet visible. Stand naturally on one leg.

metrics.targetText: Keep the hips within 8 degrees of level.
metrics.hint_good: Your hips stayed level while you balanced.
metrics.hint_high: One hip lifted or dropped. Imagine keeping a belt level across your waist.

metrics.targetText: Keep the upper body within 10 degrees of upright.
metrics.hint_good: Your upper body stayed tall and centred.
metrics.hint_high: Your body leaned to the side. Look forward and gently brace your core.

metrics.targetText: Lift the free foot clearly off the floor without raising it too high.
metrics.hint_good: Your free foot stayed clearly off the floor at a comfortable height.
metrics.hint_low: Lift the free foot a little higher so it does not brush the floor.
metrics.hint_high: You do not need to lift the free foot so high. Use a relaxed position.

metrics.targetText: Keep the support knee lined up between the hip and ankle.
metrics.hint_good: Your support knee stayed well aligned.
metrics.hint_high: The support knee moved to the side. Point it toward the toes and keep it between the hip and ankle.

metrics.targetText: Keep the hips in a steady position while balancing.
metrics.hint_high: Your body moved side to side. Focus on one point in front of you.

metrics.targetText: Keep the hips steady instead of lifting and dropping.
metrics.hint_good: Your pelvis stayed calm and stable.
metrics.hint_high: Your hips moved up and down. Gently engage the muscles on the support side.
